provider: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) of Macao SAR
coverage: Jan 2008-Sep 2026 in the API response; analysis frozen at Jul 2026 (223 months)
definition: Monthly count of visitor arrivals to Macao
transformation: Period strings parsed to first-of-month timestamps; values cast to integers; window truncated at 2026-07; phase/year/YoY/recovery fields derived
known_limitations: API rows after July 2026 are excluded by design; no interpolation

provider: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) of Macao SAR
definition: Monthly count of guests staying in hotel establishments
transformation: Aligned to the monthly visitor grid and truncated at 2026-07
known_limitations: Hotel guests are not identical to total visitors

definition: International tourism arrivals for Macao SAR
transformation: Parsed from the World Bank API JSON response and joined to GDP by year
known_limitations: Missing 2021-2025 values are retained as NaN and never interpolated

measurement_unit: current US$ per person per year
definition: GDP per capita in current US dollars for Macao SAR
transformation: Parsed from the World Bank API JSON response and joined to arrivals by year

provider: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) of Macao SAR
measurement_unit: visitor arrivals per year and source market
definition: Annual visitor arrivals and source-market breakdown
transformation: Text extracted from the official press-release page; headline market totals parsed with explicit patterns
known_limitations: Release is a narrative web page rather than a tidy machine-readable table

provider: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) of Macao SAR
measurement_unit: visitor arrivals per year and source market
definition: Annual visitor arrivals and source-market breakdown
transformation: Text extracted from the official press-release page; headline market totals parsed with explicit patterns
known_limitations: Top-eight selection is based on 2025; remaining origins are grouped as Other

definition: Visitor arrivals by land sea and air entry point
transformation: PDF text extracted and checkpoint values reconciled to the published 2025 total
known_limitations: Checkpoint table is annual; a monthly checkpoint series is not available

definition: Interim checkpoint table used for cross-checking
transformation: Retained as a provenance cross-check; not used for the final annual checkpoint values
known_limitations: Interim release is superseded by the December release

provider: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) of Macao SAR
measurement_unit: all-person arrivals and departures by checkpoint
definition: All-person border movements rather than visitor arrivals
transformation: Used only as context; not merged into visitor checkpoint shares
known_limitations: All-person counts include residents and commuters and must not be presented as tourists

provider: Statistics and Census Service (DSEC) of Macao SAR
definition: Recorded visitor person-times by district and origin
transformation: Filtered to Overall origin and months 1-7; summed by district
known_limitations: Person-times are not unique visitors; two GeoJSON zones lack a matching observation

transformation: Built by merging the downloaded per-zone JSON files; projected in EPSG:4326
known_limitations: Public boundary geometry is simplified relative to official cadastral data

definition: Point locations for named entry checkpoints
transformation: Queried with named landmark searches and checked against the map; HZMB and Hengqin coordinates adjusted to the Macao-side port area
known_limitations: Heliport coordinate is approximate; boundary and OSM positions can differ by several metres
